svg.style: background: #232F3E; background-color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); color-scheme: light dark;

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 418px; height: 1px; padding-top: 57px; margin-left: 13px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
1. IAM
The caller's identity policy and
the access point policy

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 418px; height: 1px; padding-top: 207px; margin-left: 13px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2. Network origin
VPC origin or Internet origin
It cannot be changed after creation

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 418px; height: 1px; padding-top: 357px; margin-left: 13px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
3. File system identity
One UNIX or Windows user
fixed on the access point

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 418px; height: 1px; padding-top: 507px; margin-left: 13px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4. Volume permissions
Mode bits, NFSv4 ACLs, or NTFS ACLs,
evaluated for that identity

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 398px; height: 1px; padding-top: 282px; margin-left: 473px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
VPC origin
Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS on Fargate,
Amazon EC2 and AWS Lambda in the VPC
Traffic goes through an S3 gateway endpoint

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 398px; height: 1px; padding-top: 482px; margin-left: 473px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Internet origin
Amazon Athena, AWS Glue,
Amazon EMR Serverless,
Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases,
AWS Transfer Family, Amazon CloudFront,
and AWS Lambda outside a VPC
Not public: SigV4 is required and
Block Public Access is always on

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 838px; height: 1px; padding-top: 627px; margin-left: 24px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #121212); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Notes
*1 Work back from the caller to the origin
To use one volume from Fargate and from managed services, create separate access points with different origins.
*2 One identity; per-requester ACLs are not evaluated
If the SVM cannot resolve the identity, the access point goes to FAILED after the create call succeeds (observed 2026-11-10).
*3 VPC origin refuses calls from outside the VPC, even with administrator rights
An administrator IAM principal got AccessDenied (observed 2026-11-10).
